name: Notion Education Plan
summary: Free Notion with unlimited uploads and 30-day page history for uni students.
key: Free for students at accredited colleges and universities.
need: Your uni email set as the main email on your Notion account. Student IDs aren't accepted.
how: Select Upgrade plan, then Get free education plan.
Do it on desktop or web, not mobile. If you're on a paid plan, downgrade to Free first.
catches: You must re-verify once a year with your uni email, or your workspace drops to the Free Plan.
